description: Kubernetes OpenConsole (LOG_FORMAT=ecs): decode the JSON line (no grok), derive event.outcome for audit events, and route audit / application records to logs-openconsole.audit-* / logs-openconsole.app-*. Lines from other containers are left alone. See deploy/elk/README.md.

script.source: if (ctx.event == null) { ctx.event = [:]; } boolean audit = ctx.message == 'audit'; ctx.event.dataset = audit ? 'openconsole.audit' : 'openconsole.app'; if (audit) { ctx.event.kind = 'event'; String a = ctx.event.action instanceof String ? ctx.event.action : ''; if (a.endsWith('.success')) { ctx.event.outcome = 'success'; } else if (a.endsWith('.failed') || a.endsWith('.denied') || a.endsWith('.rate_limited') || a.endsWith('.locked')) { ctx.event.outcome = 'failure'; } }
